segments.label: Segment 1
segments.vo_line: Meet Akua, the study companion built for the way you actually learn.

segments.label: Segment 2
segments.vo_line: Start by adding a course. Eduwaka reads your syllabus 20,000 times and lays out a plan you can follow at your own pace.

segments.label: Segment 3
segments.vo_line: When an exam gets close, it gathers everything you've covered and turns it into a short, focused review.

segments.label: Segment 4
segments.vo_line: Your progress saves on its own, so you can switch devices and pick up right where you left off.

segments.label: Segment 5
segments.vo_line: Give it a try this 1st week, and see how much lighter the term feels.
